# Doom of Mokhaiotl capture validation ledger

Source: `rsprox-3340-rev235.bin`, decoded as protocol `235.1`, world 679. The recording contains 57 encounters covering delves 1–15. Because the player was on a Leagues world, player damage rolls and League mastery graphics are not authoritative combat values; boss state, timings, entities, animations, graphics, projectiles, locations, and var/state transitions are authoritative.

Validation status: the integrated runtime has compiled deterministic and capture-replay coverage for the mechanics summarized below. A post-patch live client smoke has not yet been performed and remains explicitly pending.

## Values not proven by this capture

The recording does not provide authoritative standard max-hit or accuracy rolls for every delve, random mechanic weights, venom cadence, the complete volatile-earth shield construction sequence, or a non-Leagues recovery sample. The current 32-Hitpoint, 24-Prayer, and 25%-special-energy recovery contract is backed by the official 6 August 2025 update and still needs a focused non-Leagues capture before it can be marked packet-exact. The Leagues capture also cannot prove ordinary accuracy rolls: current Wiki mechanics define Rock Throw follow-ups as 100% accurate, while car projectiles use normal accuracy. Its prayer/hit serialization proves the delve-7+ impacts at debris +2/+3/+4 and six unique consecutive prayer impacts for delve 8, but the exact projectile packet launch visuals remain inferred pending that focused non-Leagues capture.
